vanilla_completion.note: 2026-09-21: where vanilla gives an ownable location a river and the network drawing does not (2,122 locations: mainstems rasterised on one bank only, e.g. Cairo; small rivers below the discharge cut; delta distributaries the downstream tree cannot carry), a one-pixel bank detour of the mainstem or a copy of vanilla's own river piece (with one pixel of clearance, as its own tree) gives the location its river. Levels: the mainstem's for detours, vanilla's widths for pieces.
